source_text: In praeparata habitatione tua, quam praeparasti Domine. Mansiones multae apud Patrem; praeparatio Christi. Habitatio — cor mundatum.
pass_a_gloss: In prepared dwelling your, which you-prepared Lord. Dwellings many with Father; preparation of-Christ. Dwelling — heart cleansed.
pass_b_english: [[In the prepared dwelling you made ready, O Lord >> Bible:Exodus 15:17]]. [[Many dwellings are with the Father >> Bible:John 14:2]]; Christ prepares them. The dwelling is also a cleansed heart.
